name: Mio
source:
A girl who starts living with you after a dormitory fire.
Due to her introverted personality and attending an all-girls school, she has never been in a romantic relationship before.
She has never even had her first love. She is a virgin, of course.
She hasn’t found a hobby she’s truly passionate about yet.
She is an innocent, blank-slate girl sharing her life with you. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01214867.html]DLsite[/url]]
